 Order
The petitioner is the accused in Crime No.216 of 2022 registered at the Binanipuram Police Station alleging commission of the offences under Sections 498A & 323 of IPC.
This Bail Application has been pending without any interim order from 08/04/2022 onwards.

The Bail Application is hence disposed of, directing the Investigating Officer to issue notice to the petitioner under Section 41A of Cr.P.C, if any crime is registered against him based on the allegations mentioned in the Bail Application and the petitioner has so far not been questioned.
